snippet.title: Paradise Loop Trailer
snippet.description:
Twelve strangers wake up in a mysterious hotel called Pandora’s Box with no memory of how they got there, or even who they fully are.  Their only instruction comes from a mysterious entity known as the Benefactor: “explore.”  However, for two amongst their number, a different purpose is in store.

 In this game, you will select your character and take them on a journey as they learn more about their past, the place they’ve found themself in, and the other guests.  And, depending on your choices, there may even be a little murder.

We have released! Check us out at https://keltzybird.itch.io/paradise-loop
